description: This Java source file defines a Spring Boot REST controller 'PredefinedShelfController' that provides endpoints to retrieve books from predefined shelves such as 'to-read', 'reading', 'read', and 'did-not-finish'. It interacts with a BookService to fetch data based on shelf names.

classes.name: PredefinedShelfController
classes.description: A REST controller managing endpoints for fetching books from predefined shelves.

methods.name: getAllToReadBooks
methods.description: Handles GET requests to retrieve all books marked as 'to-read' for the logged-in user.

methods.name: getAllReadingBooks
methods.description: Handles GET requests to retrieve all books currently being read for the logged-in user.

methods.name: getAllReadBooks
methods.description: Handles GET requests to retrieve all books that have been read for the logged-in user.

methods.name: getAllDidNotFinishBooks
methods.description: Handles GET requests to retrieve all books that were not finished for the logged-in user.
